name: HedgeDoc
description: HedgeDoc (formerly CodiMD) is a self-hosted, real-time collaborative Markdown editor. Several people can write the same note at once in the browser, with support for diagrams, math, slide presentations and per-note sharing permissions.

notes.text: There is no default account. Register the first user under Sign In with an email address and password.
Anyone who reaches the instance can register. Once your accounts exist, set "allowEmailRegister": false in /opt/hedgedoc_data/config.json and run systemctl restart hedgedoc.
Behind a reverse proxy, set domain to your hostname, urlAddPort to false and protocolUseSSL to true in config.json, then restart hedgedoc. Otherwise the page loads without scripts.
